title: Apink True or False
description: Ten true or false statements on Apink: the debut EP, hits like Mr. Chu, LUV and Dumhdurum, Japanese singles and the duo Apink Chobom.

questions.question: Apink's debut EP, released in 2011, was titled Seven Springs of Apink.
questions.fun_fact: It came out on April 19, 2011, led by Mollayo, or I Don't Know, and Lee Gi-kwang of Beast appears in its music video.

questions.question: NoNoNo was the title track of Une Année, Apink's first studio album.
questions.fun_fact: Une Année arrived in May 2012 with Hush as its title song. NoNoNo came out in July 2013 as the lead single of the EP Secret Garden.

questions.question: Apink's 2014 hit Mr. Chu was composed by Duble Sidekick.
questions.fun_fact: Digipedi directed its tennis-themed video, and Gaon's year-end chart placed it eighth among the best-selling digital songs of 2014.

questions.question: Pink LUV, Apink's fifth EP, debuted at No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart.
questions.fun_fact: Shinsadong Tiger composed the title song LUV, which earned Apink triple crowns on The Show, Show! Music Core and Inkigayo.

questions.question: Apink's first Japanese single, released in October 2014, was a Japanese version of Mr. Chu.
questions.fun_fact: Their Japanese debut single was NoNoNo, which reached No. 4 on Oricon's weekly chart. A Japanese Mr. Chu followed in February 2015.

questions.question: Apink's 2016 Japanese song Brand New Days was used as the opening theme of an anime series.
questions.fun_fact: The series was Rilu Rilu Fairilu, and the group released the song's music video on February 25, 2016.

questions.question: Apink held their first headlining concert, Pink Paradise, at Jamsil Indoor Stadium.
questions.fun_fact: Pink Paradise took place at Olympic Hall on January 30 and 31, 2015, and its 7,200 tickets went in two minutes. Jamsil hosted their second concert.

questions.question: Dumhdurum, the 2020 lead single of the EP Look, reached No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart.
questions.fun_fact: It entered at No. 4 and peaked at No. 2, and in its second week of promotion Apink won on all six weekly music shows.

questions.question: Apink Chobom, the duo of Chorong and Bomi, debuted in July 2022 with the single album Dilemma.
questions.fun_fact: Their debut single album was Copycat, a nu-disco track. The two began preparing it once Apink had wrapped up promotions for Dilemma.

questions.question: Apink marked their first anniversary with a song named after the date of their debut.
questions.fun_fact: Leader Park Cho-rong wrote its lyrics and Kim Jin-hwan composed it. Later anniversary songs include Promise U, The Wave and Thank You.

title: NCT 127: The Sticker Era
description: Ten questions on NCT 127's 2021 album Sticker: the lead single, its video, chart and sales numbers, the repackage and the world tour.

questions.question: Which instrument stands out in the sound of NCT 127's 2021 single Sticker?
questions.fun_fact: Its co-composer Dem Jointz had worked on three earlier NCT 127 singles: Cherry Bomb, Kick It and Punch.

questions.question: Which two NCT 127 members co-wrote the lyrics of Sticker with Yoo Young-jin?
questions.fun_fact: Yoo Young-jin urged the group's two rappers to write their own verses so the track would sound like NCT.

questions.question: What concept does the music video for Sticker follow?
questions.fun_fact: Its neon-lit sets mix CGI with video game touches, a look NME compared to Las Vegas.

questions.question: In 2021, the single Sticker gave NCT 127 their first entry on which Billboard chart?
questions.fun_fact: It peaked at No. 101 there, and it also opened at No. 5 on World Digital Song Sales, the group's eleventh top-five entry on that list.

questions.question: By its release day in September 2021, roughly how many pre-orders had Sticker gathered?
questions.fun_fact: That was more than four times the group's previous best of about 530,000 pre-orders, set by Neo Zone.

questions.question: Which single led the October 2021 repackage of Sticker?
questions.fun_fact: Kenzie, Darkchild and Rodnae Chikk Bell wrote it, and in November 2021 it won twice on M Countdown and once on Show! Music Core.

questions.question: What was the name of the tour NCT 127 launched in December 2021 in support of Sticker?
questions.fun_fact: Running until January 2023, the tour played 28 shows in 17 cities and drew more than 700,000 spectators.

questions.question: Which Seoul venue hosted the December 2021 opening shows of NCT 127's tour for Sticker?
questions.fun_fact: Under COVID-19 rules only 5,000 fans were let in and shouting was banned, so the crowd cheered by clapping.

questions.question: Sticker, released on September 17, 2021, is which of NCT 127's Korean-language studio albums?
questions.fun_fact: It followed the Korean albums Regular-Irregular and Neo Zone (March 2020), and the Japanese EP Loveholic had come out earlier in 2021, in February.

questions.question: On which American talk show did NCT 127 perform Sticker when the album came out in September 2021?
options: The Late Late Show with James Corden
The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
questions.fun_fact: Before release, a teaser called Who Is Sticker cast the members as engineering students by day and computer hackers by night.

title: Korea's Year-End Chart Toppers
description: Ten years of South Korea's biggest hits: name the song or artist that ended each year at No. 1 on the Gaon, now Circle, Digital Chart.

questions.question: Which song finished first on the Gaon Digital Chart's year-end ranking for 2011?
questions.fun_fact: T-ara's song never reached No. 1 on a weekly or monthly Gaon chart that year, yet it still led the full-year ranking.

questions.question: Which song topped the Gaon Digital Chart's year-end list for 2013?
questions.fun_fact: Psy's single held the weekly top spot for two weeks in April 2013 and was also the best performer of that month.

questions.question: Which song ranked No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart's year-end list for 2014?
questions.fun_fact: The duet by Soyou and Junggigo spent two weeks at No. 1 in February 2014 and was that month's top song as well.

questions.question: Which BIGBANG single was the Gaon Digital Chart's best-performing song of 2015?
questions.fun_fact: G-Dragon wrote and composed it with Teddy Park, and Gaon counted 1,581,284 downloads of it over the year.

questions.question: Which singer had the Gaon Digital Chart's best-performing song of 2017?
questions.fun_fact: Her song for the drama Guardian: The Lonely and Great God, composed by the duo Rocoberry, led Gaon's yearly digital, download and streaming charts.

questions.question: Which song was the Gaon Digital Chart's best-performing single of 2019?
questions.fun_fact: Sung by English singer Anne-Marie, it was the first foreign song to end a year at the top of the chart, and it also led the June 2019 monthly chart.

questions.question: Which artist had the Gaon Digital Chart's best-performing song of 2020?
questions.fun_fact: His single Any Song spent seven weeks at No. 1 on the weekly chart in 2020, and Changmo's Meteor came second for the year.

questions.question: Which song was the Gaon Digital Chart's year-end No. 1 for 2021?
questions.fun_fact: IU's single held No. 1 for six weeks from late January 2021, and she spent twelve weeks on top that year with four different songs.

questions.question: Which song topped the Circle Digital Chart's year-end list for 2022?
questions.fun_fact: IVE's song held No. 1 for four weeks in a row, a run the group matched later that year with After Like.

questions.question: Which song was the Circle Digital Chart's year-end No. 1 for 2025?
questions.fun_fact: Woodz first released it on his 2023 EP OO-LI, and it reached No. 1 on the weekly chart in May 2025, more than two years later.

title: NCT DREAM: From Chewing Gum to Smoothie
description: Ten easy questions on NCT DREAM: the label, the first win, the old graduation rule, singles from Ridin' to Smoothie and the members.

questions.question: Which agency formed NCT DREAM as a unit of NCT?
questions.fun_fact: NCT DREAM was the third NCT sub-unit to debut, after NCT U and NCT 127.

questions.question: With which song did NCT DREAM win their first music show trophy, in February 2017?
questions.fun_fact: The win came on February 14, 2017, on the 100th episode of The Show, and the song led their single album The First.

questions.question: In which year did SM end NCT DREAM's graduation system?
questions.fun_fact: Mark, who had left under the old rule on December 31, 2018, rejoined the unit once the change took effect.

questions.question: Which EP was announced as Mark's last comeback with NCT DREAM before his graduation?
questions.fun_fact: Released in September 2018, it included a Mandarin version of its title song and became the unit's second No. 1 on the Gaon Album Chart.

questions.question: Ridin' was the lead single of which 2020 NCT DREAM EP?
questions.fun_fact: Recorded by the six members of the time, the five-track EP took the group to No. 1 on Billboard's Emerging Artists chart for the first time.

questions.question: In the 2024 video for Smoothie, NCT DREAM play a real-life version of which mobile game?
questions.fun_fact: Smoothie led the EP Dream()scape, a title pronounced dream escape, released on March 25, 2024.

questions.question: In April 2022, Glitch Mode became NCT DREAM's first entry on which US chart?
questions.fun_fact: The second studio album entered at No. 50, and at home it opened at No. 1 on the monthly Gaon chart with 1,646,949 copies sold.

questions.question: Which of these idols is a member of NCT DREAM?
questions.fun_fact: Renjun was one of the five new faces who joined Mark and Haechan when SM announced NCT DREAM in August 2016.

questions.question: Which NCT DREAM member teamed up with Jeno in NCT JNJM, the NCT unit formed in 2026?
questions.fun_fact: NCT JNJM became NCT's seventh sub-unit and released its first EP, Both Sides, on February 23, 2026.

questions.question: NCT DREAM sang Trigger the Fever as the official song of which 2017 tournament in South Korea?
questions.fun_fact: The unit served as the tournament's official ambassadors and sang the song at its opening ceremony.

title: K-pop Songs With Foreign Titles
description: Ten K-pop songs with titles in Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and more: match each one to the artist or album behind it.

questions.question: Which group released Hola Hola as the title track of its 2017 debut EP?
questions.fun_fact: The music video shows the members traveling through Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Mexico and Brazil.

questions.question: Which girl group released the single Adios in August 2019?
questions.fun_fact: It led the single album Hush. On Billboard's World Digital Song Sales it got as high as No. 2 and charted for six weeks in all.

questions.question: Senorita (2019) was the title track of which (G)I-DLE EP?
questions.fun_fact: Soyeon wrote the lyrics and produced it with Big Sancho, using castanets and brass to give it a flamenco flavor.

questions.question: Mamacita (2014) led the seventh Korean studio album of which boy group?
questions.fun_fact: Teddy Riley co-composed it, and the western-themed video casts the members as a sheriff, a matador and a robber, among others.

questions.question: Which girl group released Mamma Mia in August 2014, its first release with Heo Youngji?
questions.fun_fact: Duble Sidekick composed the song, which led the EP Day & Night. Heo Youngji had won her spot on the TV show Kara Project.

questions.question: Bon Voyage, released in September 2020, marked the solo debut of which Oh My Girl member?
questions.fun_fact: It was a five-song EP from WM Entertainment, led by a title track of the same name.

questions.question: Coup d'Etat (2013) was the title track of which rapper's second studio album?
questions.fun_fact: American DJs Diplo and Baauer feature on it as co-producers, and it samples Gil Scott-Heron's The Revolution Will Not Be Televised.

questions.question: Which group's 2022 single Maison takes its title from the French word for home?
questions.fun_fact: A coded teaser hid the title before release, and the song pleads for the Earth to be saved from global warming and pollution.

questions.question: Suki to Iwasetai, a Japanese title meaning Tell Me You Love Me, was the 2019 Japanese debut single of which group?
questions.fun_fact: Yasushi Akimoto produced it and wrote its lyrics, and it entered Oricon's weekly singles chart at No. 2 with 221,640 copies sold.

questions.question: Luna, a 2021 lead single that sets gayageum strings over trap beats, is by which boy group?
questions.fun_fact: It led the EP Blood Moon and brought the group its first music show win, on Show Champion on November 17, 2021.
